title: How to Upload a Schematic?
summary: How to submit a TheySix Minecraft farm Litematica schematic for review and possible addition to the Farm Vault?

body.content: Submit TheySix Minecraft farm Litematica schematics in [#📤╏submissions](https://discord.com/channels/985227944236568606/1559942519482089492) for review and possible addition to the [TheySix Farm Vault](https://theysix.ro-mihaiu.xyz/). The schematic must match an existing TheySix farm from the database.

items.content: Use the `Needs Verification` tag. Anyone can apply this tag.
Rename the post using `DN | Farm Type`. For example: `530 | Bonemeal`.
Use the farm's database number as the DN, then choose its primary farm type.

body.content: The available farm types are: `bonemeal`, `cobblestone`, `creeper`, `duper`, `gold`, `iron`, `kelp`, `lava`, `mob`, `raid`, `resin`, `sand`, `shulker`, `smelter`, `sugarcane`, `tnt`, `wither-skeleton`, `wood`, `wool`, and `xp`.

items.content: Drag the `.litematic` file directly into your post.
Wait until Discord finishes uploading the file, then send the post.
Complete the submission template in the post.
Open the uploaded file and choose `Share` or `Copy link`.
Make sure people with the link can download the file.
Paste the link beside `Litematica download:` in the template.

body.content: Reviews normally take 2 to 48 hours. A moderator will apply `APPROVED` if the schematic is valid and matches the TheySix farm. They may apply `Rejected / Duplicate` if it is incomplete, invalid, already submitted, or does not match the original farm.

Do not make duplicate posts while a submission is being reviewed. Update your existing post instead. Members whose schematics are successfully verified may receive the contributor role as thanks for improving the vault.
